title: Editorial review of the annual report
need: The annual report goes to the governing board in December and needs an independent editorial review for clarity and consistency.
objective: A board-ready text that reads consistently across chapters.
scope: Structural and line edit of nine chapters, one round of revisions after author comments, a style sheet for future editions.

deliverables.item: Revised text after author comments and style sheet

qualifications: Professional editor with experience on institutional reports in English.
